title: Honey Hunt

outfit_card.silhouette: A-line midi dress with layered apron-like overskirt, cinched waist, voluminous sheer bishop sleeves, and a wide-brimmed bonnet with trailing veil for a pastoral couture line.
outfit_card.headpiece_and_hair_ornaments: Wide-brimmed straw hat with a gingham band, hexagonal honeycomb lace trim, and a long sheer tulle veil that drapes over the shoulders.
outfit_card.upper_garment_and_sleeves: High-neck chiffon blouse under a honeycomb-patterned lace vest, featuring pintucked bodice, gold braided trim, faux pearl buttons, and sheer organza bishop sleeves with lace cuffs.
outfit_card.lower_garment_and_legwear: Layered midi skirt with a white base and a yellow overlay featuring hexagonal lace applique, pleated waistband, and white lace-trimmed ankle socks paired with cream Mary Jane heels.
outfit_card.signature_props_and_motifs: A bee-shaped brooch, honeycomb-patterned belt, and a woven straw basket with a honey jar and floral sprigs.
